verdict.rationale: Deepgram documents a pre-recorded transcription endpoint (POST https://api.deepgram.com/v1/listen) and has a dedicated pre-recorded audio guide. An OpenAPI spec is published, and the dg CLI can transcribe files, so the core submission path is evidenced. Nothing in the pack shows published accepted audio/video formats or file-size limits, and local-file upload (as opposed to a URL) is only implied by the CLI. Missing for 10: published list of accepted audio/video formats, published file-size limits, explicit documentation of local file upload to the endpoint, independent hands-on corroboration.
